definitions.explanation: A fake or fraudulently made banknote intended to look like genuine currency. Manufacturing and using counterfeit money is a criminal offense.

examples.japanese: {偽札|にせさつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
{偽札|にせさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧だ。
examples.english: Using counterfeit money is a crime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{紙幣|しへい}→紙幣：00363_shihei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{偽札|にせさつ}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Many anti-counterfeiting technologies are used in the new banknotes.

notes:
{偽札|にせさつ} combines ⟦{偽|にせ}→偽：10155_nise⟧ (fake, counterfeit) + ⟦{札|さつ}→札：02153_satsu⟧ (banknote). Can also be read {偽札|ぎさつ} in more formal or legal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偽札|にせさつ}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (counterfeit prevention)
- {偽札|にせさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make counterfeit bills)
- {偽札|にせさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use counterfeit bills)
- {偽札|にせさつ}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ (counterfeiting incident)
- {偽札|にせさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見分|みわ}ける→見分ける：06348_miwakeru⟧ (to distinguish counterfeit bills)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has a very low rate of counterfeiting due to advanced anti-counterfeiting technology in its banknotes. Japanese ⟦{紙幣|しへい}→紙幣：00363_shihei⟧ (banknotes) feature {透|す}かし (watermarks), ホログラム (holograms), and other security features.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{偽造|ぎぞう}→偽造：11524_gizou⟧⟦{紙幣|しへい}→紙幣：00363_shihei⟧: forged banknote (formal/legal term)
- ⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧: fake, counterfeit item (general term for any fake)
- {贋作|がんさく}: forgery (typically art or documents)
